map.算术平均 x̄ = Σx / n；几何平均 = (∏x)^(1/n)；调和平均: Arithmetic mean x_bar = sum of x / n; geometric mean = (product of x)^(1/n); harmonic mean = n / sum of (1/x). Geometric and harmonic means require positive data.
map.在文本框输入数据，用逗号或空格分隔（如 1, 2, 4）。: Enter data in the text box separated by commas or spaces (e.g. 1, 2, 4).
map.结果区显示三种均值、总和 Σ 与个数 n。: The result area shows the three means, the sum and the count n.
